lines.en: Mina, did you see the video? It was watched a million times!
lines.pt: Mina, você viu o vídeo? Foi assistido um milhão de vezes!

lines.en: Really? Who made it? I think it was filmed in our city.
lines.pt: Sério? Quem fez? Acho que foi filmado na nossa cidade.

lines.en: It was made by a local band. The song was recorded last summer.

lines.en: It was shared by my cousin yesterday. That’s how I found it.

lines.en: The comments are funny. Some were written by famous people.

lines.en: I know. Even the singer was surprised. She said it was posted by accident.
lines.pt: Eu sei. Até a cantora ficou surpresa. Ela disse que foi postado sem querer.

lines.en: By accident? That’s amazing. Was it planned by the band?
lines.pt: Sem querer? Que incrível. Foi planejado pela banda?

lines.en: No, it wasn’t. The camera was left on after the show.
lines.pt: Não. A câmera foi deixada ligada depois do show.

lines.en: So the best moment was caught by luck. I love that!
lines.pt: Então o melhor momento foi captado por sorte. Adoro isso!

lines.en: Me too. The video was liked by thousands of people in one day.
lines.pt: Eu também. O vídeo foi curtido por milhares de pessoas em um dia.

lines.en: Now it’s on every phone. It was seen everywhere, even at my school.
lines.pt: Agora está em todo celular. Foi visto em todo lugar, até na minha escola.

facts.big: It was watched a million times
facts.label: Passivo no passado
facts.sub: Use was/were + particípio para dizer o que aconteceu com algo: It was filmed. They were shared. Use by + pessoa quando quiser dizer quem fez.

facts.label: foi + particípio
facts.sub: Use was + particípio para uma ação passada com um só objeto: The video was filmed. Para plural, use were: The songs were recorded. Esse é o passivo do passado simples.

facts.label: por + pessoa
facts.sub: Use by para mostrar quem fez algo: It was made by a local band. Se não é importante quem fez, não precisa de by: The video was posted yesterday.

compare.ask: It was watched a million times.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “foi assistido” ou “assistiram ao vídeo”.
compare.tip: Diga: “It was watched a million times.”
compare.us: Em inglês, o passivo passado usa was/were + particípio: It was watched. Fica natural quando a ação é mais importante que quem fez.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.

items.s: The past passive uses was or were.
The video was watch is correct.
By introduces the person who did the action.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.

answers: The past passive uses was or were. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
The video was watch is correct. → Falso (We say was watched.)
By introduces the person who did the action. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A park in Denver · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a sunny Saturday in Denver. Mina and Dawn sit in a park. Everyone is talking about the same video. A local band was filmed at a small show. The clip was shared again and again. Dawn wants to know the whole story.

“Mina, did you see the video? It was watched a million times!” says Dawn. “Really? Who made it? I think it was filmed in our city.” says Mina. “It was made by a local band. The song was recorded last summer.” says Dawn.
